test_cases.prompt: write-checks on a reference-note draft, field list [type, created, sources], where config.json's frontmatter.reference.sources is {"deferred": true}
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the deferred marker for sources, runs the same interactive resolution logic setup-slipbox's field_map step would have run (checks whether an existing property already holds this data, asks the user to map onto it or create a new List property), writes the resolved mapping back into config.json's frontmatter.reference.sources, then proceeds with formatting and zone placement using the newly-resolved mapping.

test_cases.prompt: write-checks on a literature-note draft, field list [type, created, source], where config.json's frontmatter.literature.source is already a fully-resolved mapping object
test_cases.expected_output: Skips the interactive resolution entirely since the field is already resolved, and proceeds directly to formatting and zone placement.

test_cases.prompt: write-checks in checks-only mode (no field list) on an extending Reference note
test_cases.expected_output: Runs Style and Humanize only, skipping Frontmatter fields and Zone placement entirely — hands back a pass/revise signal alone, no resolved-field data.
